# Hi, I'm Emi

I am an M.S. Data Science candidate at Drew University, graduating in August 2026. I build practical analytics, forecasting, and machine-learning solutions using Python, SQL, and business intelligence tools. My work spans healthcare demand forecasting, audience sentiment analysis, and data storytelling.

Before graduate school, I spent more than six years leading cross-functional VFX and animation teams. That experience strengthened my ability to manage complex projects, communicate with technical and creative stakeholders, and deliver polished work on schedule.

## Selected Projects

### Predicting Emergency Department Demand

Built a one-quarter-ahead forecasting prototype for total ED encounters across 57 New York facility counties and 28 quarters. Developed a leakage-safe data pipeline, compared machine-learning models with operational benchmarks, and found that previous-quarter persistence achieved the best 2024 holdout performance (**MAE 1,253; WAPE 3.36%**). Deployed the stakeholder workflow as a Flask application on Render.

**Tools:** Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, Flask, Render  
[View Project](projects/predicting-emergency-department-demand.html) | [Open Live App](https://ny-quarterly-ed-demand-app.onrender.com/){target="_blank"}

### Manga Sentiment Analysis

Created an end-to-end text-analysis pipeline that collected more than 90 audience reviews using Selenium, processed the text with NLTK and TextBlob, and communicated sentiment patterns through Tableau and Power BI dashboards.

**Tools:** Python, Selenium, NLTK, TextBlob, Tableau, Power BI  
[View Project](projects/manga-sentiment.html)

### EV Adoption in Washington

Analyzed more than 235,000 Washington State EV registration records to examine adoption growth, leading brands, electric range, and geographic concentration. Transformed the findings into a focused four-visual data story using Polars and Plotly.

**Tools:** Python, Polars, Plotly  
[View Project](projects/ev-adoption.html)
